messages:
alex: Quick sync — I'm iterating on an SLA-driven cost card for Console. Goal: surface per-route token burn, cache savings (prefetch + KV), and the modeled SLA cost of switching to lower-cost model variants. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/cost-card-proto
miriam: Nice. When you say "modeled SLA cost" do you mean expected latency change + dollars? Or just dollars?
alex: both — main column is $/1000 tokens (observed) + shadow column that simulates switching routing policy to cheaper model (est latency, P95 delta, and token delta). We need clarity on attribution.
jon: Data question: do we trust sampled telemetry for cache hits? Our sampling blows up error for low-volume routes.
alex: Good point. Plan is hybrid: full-coverage token accounting (from router logs) + sampled cache hit rate to estimate savings for small routes. For large routes we use exact cache records.
sam: Concern: showing "projected savings" might encourage aggressive routing changes that break quality. Need guardrails, open in UI: "Quality risk" flag and link to evals.
tara: For rollouts: can we tie the card to canary experiments? i.e., show card per rollout stage + projected burn if canary promoted.
jon: API-level: we'll need an endpoint returning per-route tuples: [observed_tokens, observed_cost, cache_hits_estimate, model_variant_simulations]. What's the shape? JSON or proto?
alex: Prefer JSON from metrics service for the dashboard. Example proto in design doc but let's keep dashboard exchange JSON for now. Example query snippet:
```
-- tokenized sample
SELECT sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost) AS cost, avg(cache_hit_rate) AS hit_rate FROM route_metrics WHERE route_id = $1 AND ts >= $2
```
miriam: UX note: add a confidence ribbon (±) and a "what-if slider" that simulates % of traffic rerouted.
sam: Also need SLO overlay (P50/P95) so product teams see latency tradeoff. And a "lock" button to prevent automatic routing changes.
alex: Action items: (1) I will add mockups with confidence ribbon & what-if slider; (2) @jon will draft API schema for per-route simulation; (3) @miriam add copy & quality risk states; (4) @tara wire up canary tag mapping. I'll post updates later today.
deploy-bot: deploy preview for feature/eng/cost-card at commit 9f3a2e — available at https://staging.console.redwood.internal/cost-card
jon: ack, will start API sketch after standup.
miriam: thanks everyone. small ask: include per-model quantization flag in payload (q4_q8) so cost sim matches real model variants.
alex: noted — adding quantization & SKU mapping. Thanks :thumbsup:
